summary.headline: Monthly Thunder Omens, August–December
summary.text: Thunder and earthquake omens for August through December, associated with Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, and Aquarius. Predictions include wars, famine, destruction of crops, livestock, reptiles, and people, migration, disease, harsh or late winters, and occasional prosperity or joy.
